question: test_template_lowers_rmsd[1y57] templates-ON: is our wider upper tail (a) model/input property, (b) small-N noise, (c) port defect
verdict_detail: Model/input property. Upstream's own implementation shows the same wide ON tail on its CUDA-family backend (per-sample 8.6-22.8 A, 5 distinct draws replayed on two machines; test_templates.py 1y57 calibration note). Our device max 22.21 A sits inside that envelope at a matching tail rate (our 4/24 >= 16 A vs their >=1/5). The tight 8.2-15.5 A band is specific to CPU/MPS-class numerics: our matched-N control of upstream's own model on CPU fp32 stays <= 15.84 A at N=24. Not (b): the tail persists at N=24 and the wide/tight split pooled across both implementations is real (Fisher p 0.020). Not (c): every port-specific suspect is controlled (array-identical alignment npz, same one-row dummy MSA, same checkpoint of3-p2-155k, same metric best_ca_rmsd, fp32 diffusion sampler on device, host-side MT19937 noise same RNG backend as the CPU control, per-sample seeding replays committed values across hosts to 0.022 A, confidence ranking not in the per-sample distribution); the means are indistinguishable (Welch p 0.39).
